In 2024, 92.5% of all new power generation capacity came from renewable energy - a historic shift. AI is rapidly transforming energy systems, including lowering energy costs by around 10% through smart grids, enhancing grid stability, storage, and energy optimization. 

However, at the same time this last year of AI electricity usage was roughly 80TWh, set to double over the next 2-3 years. which could have equivalently provided basic energy access including lighting and some home appliances for over 200 million people, based on Tier 3 access at a minimum of 365KWh per person annually. 

How do you believe the future of AI and energy will both contribute to and challenge the pathways for countries? I appreciate all ideas shared in the comments, I really enjoy to hear your views.
